integrity: All analytical sign steps are given in RESULT.md. Exact polynomial checks and high-precision diagnostic roots are reproducible using check.py. Finite numerical checks are not substituted for the infinite-sign proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the conditional Brownian first-passage coefficient of variation with exponential mortality, instantaneous Poisson resetting to the initial position, and a point target. It refines known first-passage moment formulas and proves a global zero count; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Two resetting-rate fluctuation crossings in mortal Brownian search: a sharp noise phase diagram
